Figure 1:Policy-adaptive assessment of an agent trajectory.
The request, tool call, and successful delivery are identical
in both cases; only the governing policy changes.
The guard jointly considers the supplied policy and the
recorded interaction, generates an overall analysis, and
outputs the violated rule identifiers orNRwhen no rule is violated.
The analysis is generated by the guard and does not
represent the assessed agent’s internal reasoning.

Figure 2:Overview of AdaGuard.
AdaptiveSafety supports supervised initialization through variation
in policies and agent behavior.
SafePO evaluates complete responses using structured verdict rewards
and distributes their group-relative learning signals through
value-guided token weights.
Separate normalization preserves fixed analysis and verdict weight
budgets.
The value model and frozen reference are used only during training.
